symptom: SIGKILL during a zeros-dev lifecycle left an empty run-lock directory, so later commands failed with receipt_busy and could not reuse the saved intent.
rule: Persist owner PID, boot/namespace and process-start identity before work. Reclaim only with proof that the same-host owner is dead, never by age. Fence competing reclaimers, keep live or unverifiable owners busy, and preserve signed idempotency keys. Test with a real killed child and deterministic contention barriers.
